item: 非创作 Skill 交付路径

behavior.planningOnly: 只做计划，报告不要动：阶段成果 PlanDraft，报告版本保持，行动 0
behavior.researchOnly: 先研究，不开始写报告：阶段成果 EvidencePack 摘要，报告版本保持
behavior.reviewOnly: 只复盘，不创建行动：阶段成果 ReviewFindings，行动 0
behavior.resume: 恢复为 WAITING_INPUT + waitingFor=OBSERVATION，等待新资料/新指令，不重复运行同一阶段
behavior.reportAndActions: 未写 AgentMissionOutput、未创建 ActionItem/外部写入

unitTests.command: npm.cmd test -- tests/v2SkillArtifacts.test.ts tests/v2FirstSlice.test.ts tests/v2DelegationIdempotency.test.ts tests/v2DelegationEntry.test.ts tests/missionRuntime.test.ts

browser.command: npm.cmd exec tsx -- scripts/v2-entry-demo.ts  然后  npm.cmd exec tsx -- scripts/verify-v2-stage-artifacts.ts（全新演示库）
checks: normal entry: plan-only delegation delivered a viewable, source-backed stage artifact and no report revision
stage artifact sources resolve to the original imported material
resume is explicit and recoverable; delivered artifact and report stay untouched

lint.command: npm.cmd exec eslint -- lib/skills lib/mission lib/evaluation components/v2 scripts/v2-entry-demo.ts scripts/verify-v2-stage-artifacts.ts tests/v2SkillArtifacts.test.ts

build.command: NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-v2-build + isolated DATABASE_URL, LLM_MODE=mock: npm.cmd run build -- --webpack

compatibility.web: 工作台新增 stageArtifacts/reasonCode；只读页面构建通过
compatibility.harmonyos: 未改 ArkTS 契约；新增字段可忽略
compatibility.v1: v1 finish 语义未改；非 v2 路径不走阶段成果

remaining: 阶段成果暂不进入采纳/外发流程（本轮刻意保持只读）
未用真实模型验证该路径（本轮无付费授权）
